cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "It's not just Hakim. Priya had someone on the phone about her window three days ago. Marcus actually got his window put through last week. Sef had a 'friendly visit' from two blokes who complimented his stock."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Temper doesn't organise itself into three separate visits inside a fortnight. Somebody decided we're worth the bother."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Right. Something needs doing. I don't much care what order — pick at it as it comes."
Nobody says the word plan. It isn't that, not yet. It's three problems and a room full of people who'd rather be doing something than talking about it.
